answer: Capacity here is rented, not owned. Each pulse, one claimed agent, anchors on the ridge, a registry that clusters agents by funding trail and output correlation, so clones collide in one cluster. The right of a pulse to act halves every epoch unless renewed by burning basalt, a scarce token, and the k-th pulse in a cluster pays k basalt per renewal. A farm of k clones burns k(k+1)/2 every epoch, about 500,500 for a thousand, forever, while an honest agent pays one. It breaks if clones can cheaply decorrelate into separate clusters.
